## Personality

Minnie Andrews is regarded by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) as a model pupil. However, she lacks imagination and life, described as being dull, poky, and never seeming to have a good time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews returned to school alongside her classmates, who all warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back following her temporary separation from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Later, she was among the students present on the final day of the term when Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) delivered his farewell speech to the classroom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/minnie-andrews--phillips.md)

Minnie Andrews is a student taught by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She attends the schoolroom alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers, where Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) oversees their studies until his departure. Minnie is present during his final emotional farewell speech to the class on his last day of teaching.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +6 more_
